tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: List the frames Normascope tracks in this project: label, screenshot name, mode (fidelity/baseline), design source, and whether a capture exists yet.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Capture screenshots of the running app for the configured frames (their routes/selectors). Origin policy is default-deny: only configured origins can be captured; private/link-local/metadata addresses are always refused.

url.description: Optional base URL override. Must match a configured origin; refused otherwise.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Run the visual comparison and return the structured summary. Two modes: with no arguments, compares the configured frames (fidelity/baseline per config). With `target` (a mock PNG path inside the project) and `url`, runs the zero-config target-mock flow: capture the URL, diff against the mock. The aligned mismatch percent is the primary score; lower is better.

target.description: Path to a mock/reference PNG inside the project (zero-config mode).

url.description: URL to capture in zero-config mode. Must match a configured origin.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to capture instead of the full page.

width.description: Viewport width for the capture (match the mock's width).

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Return the structured summary of the most recent comparison (summary.json v2: per-frame aligned mismatch %, SSIM, drifted sections, mode, source, flagged).

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain WHY flagged frames drifted, as structured findings (hypotheses — verify before applying; nothing is auto-applied). Two modes: BYO — with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the server env, analysis runs locally against your own key. Org credits — with NORMASCOPE_CLOUD_URL + NORMASCOPE_ORG_KEY set, the current summary is uploaded to Normascope Cloud and analyzed there (metered in credits; findings gain history context). Deterministic diff scores are never affected by this tool.

frame.description: Screenshot filename to analyze; omit to analyze all flagged frames.

deep.description: Use the deep model (costs more; BYO bills your key, org mode uses 3 credits).
